name: Wireless Network Discovery
description: Passive wireless scanning during recon reveals the target's network infrastructure without generating traffic or triggering alerts. This identifies SSIDs in use (which may reveal naming conventions, vendors, or segmentation), security protocols, the presence of guest networks, and potentially hidden SSIDs. A directional antenna allows selective scanning of specific areas or floors of a building. This intelligence feeds directly into wireless attack planning and rogue AP strategy.

blue.det: Wireless scanning tools produce probe requests; unusual 802.11 probe patterns near perimeter; WIDS alerts.
blue.cm: Wireless Intrusion Detection System (WIDS); minimize SSID broadcast range; 5GHz-only networks.
